readerCopy.body: A change expected to be disruptive can feel more like relief once a restrictive rule or expectation actually falls away. When Uranus trines Lilith, disruption and autonomy reinforce each other, making it easier to break a routine, tradition, social expectation, or arrangement that had become constraining. Freedom does not require unnecessary wreckage to count. The useful change is the one that leaves more room to choose while preserving what never needed to be destroyed.
